# Sticker outline maker

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/sticker-maker/

Add an outline to a transparent cutout and export a PNG sticker. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Use a transparent PNG from the background remover and add a white border around its silhouette.

## Limits and checks

This tool outlines existing transparency. For a subject cutout, remove the background first using the linked background-removal tool.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
